# [rattler-build](../index.md) [generate-recipe](index.md) cran

Generate a recipe for an R package from CRAN

## Usage
```
rattler-build generate-recipe cran [OPTIONS] <PACKAGE>
```

## Arguments
- <a id="arg-PACKAGE" href="#arg-PACKAGE">`<PACKAGE>`</a>
:  Name of the package to generate
<br>**required**: `true`

## Options
- <a id="arg---universe" href="#arg---universe">`--universe (-u) <UNIVERSE>`</a>
:  The R Universe to fetch the package from (defaults to `cran`)
- <a id="arg---tree" href="#arg---tree">`--tree (-t)`</a>
:  Also create recipes for the dependencies that are not available in the `--check-available` channels (default: conda-forge)
- <a id="arg---all" href="#arg---all">`--all`</a>
:  With `--tree`, create recipes for every dependency, without checking whether it is already available
- <a id="arg---check-available" href="#arg---check-available">`--check-available <CHANNEL>`</a>
:  Check dependencies against this channel (can be repeated) and warn about the ones it doesn't have
<br>May be provided more than once.
- <a id="arg---write" href="#arg---write">`--write (-w)`</a>
:  Whether to write the recipe to a folder
- <a id="arg---maintainer" href="#arg---maintainer">`--maintainer (-m) <GITHUB_ID>`</a>
:  GitHub handle(s) to list under `extra.recipe-maintainers` (repeatable)
<br>May be provided more than once.
- <a id="arg---staged-recipes" href="#arg---staged-recipes">`--staged-recipes`</a>
:  Shape the recipe for a conda-forge staged-recipes submission: download through conda-forge's `cran_mirror` variant, leave out the `skip` for a minimum R version, require the C standard library next to the compilers and append the package's DESCRIPTION file for reviewers
